verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Unity exposes scripting/editor APIs and packages (unity-docs-11, unity-docs-13) but nothing documents a versioning scheme or deprecation policy for these APIs, and probes show no OpenAPI spec or machine-readable API docs (unity-probe-3, unity-probe-2). Missing for 10: any documented API versioning scheme, deprecation notices/timelines, or changelog policy for Unity's scripting/runtime APIs.
